question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "**skills**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Blank 3 in the given passage will represent a set of training or knowledge that is provided by way of education. **
 
• In the context of the question, it makes sense to fill in the blank with "skills" because the other options (codes, norms, branches) don't fit grammatically or logically.
 
• **The word "skills" refers to a person's ability to do something well, usually as a result of training or experience**.
 
 
• Example: "She has excellent communication skills, which make her a valuable asset to the team."
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 3.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 - codes: This refers to a system of rules or principles used to guide behavior or decision-making.(संहिता)

 
 
• Example: "The company's code of conduct outlines the expected behavior of all employees."
 
 
 
• Option 2 - norms: This refers to the unwritten rules or expectations of behavior within a particular social group or culture.(मानदंड)
 
 
• Example: "In some cultures, it is considered impolite to speak loudly in public."
 
 
 
• Option 4 - branches: This refers to a division or subdivision of an organization or government.(शाखाओं)
 
 
• Example: "The company has several branches located throughout the country."
